Reveals that follow the scroll

Each section below sits at opacity 0 while the page is at the top, where the hidden share is measured, and shows once a visitor scrolls to it. A scan that scrolls to each one and looks leaves them out of the hidden share; the stalled block at the end still counts.

Automated material movement

Autonomous vehicles keep every machine supplied. Raw materials and finished parts flow between stations without a forklift queue, and the floor plan adapts as the order book changes from one week to the next, so capacity follows demand instead of lagging it.

Operators see where every pallet is, what it carries and where it goes next.

Intelligent workflows

Software assigns and tracks tasks, gives operators contextual nudges and lifts productivity across shifts. People handle the strategy and automation handles the repetition, one stage at a time as the visitor scrolls through the track.

Downtime, eliminated before it starts

Sensors watch machine health and flag failures early.
